name: Achird
description: A naked-eye star 6.0 parsecs away, the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 4614: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.623 +/- 0.004 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.039 +/- 0.004

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 4614: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 0.972 +/- 0.012

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 4614: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6003 +/- 24

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 425040000962559616 (quality A), from 2018A&A...616A...7S; Gaia DR3 measures none

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 4614: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 168.01 +/- 0.48 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 6 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.623 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.039 solar radii and 6,003 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 4614: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
